name: Sunken Temple
description: A ruined temple of a forgotten civilization, buried deep under the ocean waves.
visualTheme: Coral-encrusted marble pillars and submerged ceremonial halls where glowing sea anemones light the path.

history.createdWhy: Dedicated to the ancient sea god Neptune by the precursor civilization.
history.majorEvents: Sank into the ocean when the precursors' mainland collapsed during the Cataclysm.
history.whyExists: Houses the primordial water crystal that keeps the oceans in balance.
history.currentConflicts: Corrupted deep-sea cultists are trying to shatter the water crystal to drown the surface world.

ecosystem.weather: Submerged cold waters with ancient echoes
